label: TL-PA9020P AV2000 powerline adapter
description: HomePlug AV2 2x2 MIMO powerline adapter rated AV2000 (2000 Mbps PHY; expect roughly gigabit-class real throughput). Two Gigabit Ethernet ports plus a filtered 16 A passthrough socket so the wall outlet is not lost.

label: TL-PA8010P AV1300 passthrough powerline adapter
description: HomePlug AV2 MIMO adapter rated AV1300 (1300 Mbps PHY, several hundred Mbps real throughput). One Gigabit Ethernet port and a 16 A filtered passthrough socket; sold singly and as a starter kit.

label: PG2400P G.hn2400 passthrough powerline kit
description: G.hn (HomeGrid) 2x2 MIMO powerline kit, G.hn2400 class with transmission speeds up to 1428 Mbps. Each adapter has 2x Gigabit Ethernet, a 16 A passthrough socket, and is deliberately not interoperable with HomePlug AV/AV2.

label: NETGEAR Powerline 2000 + Extra Outlet (PLP2000)
description: HomePlug AV2 MIMO powerline adapter at 2000 Mbps PHY. Two Gigabit Ethernet ports act as a small switch and the adapter carries a noise-filtered extra power outlet; Push-and-Secure button for 128-bit AES pairing.

label: NETGEAR Powerline 1200 Extender (PL1200)
description: HomePlug AV2 MIMO wall-plug adapter at 1200 Mbps PHY with a single 10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet port. No passthrough outlet; pick-a-plug LED for outlet selection, up to 16 adapters per network.

label: devolo Magic 2 LAN powerline adapter
description: G.hn (HomeGrid Forum) powerline adapter, 2400 Mbps MIMO / 1200 Mbps SISO PHY over 500 m of mains wiring. One Gigabit Ethernet port and a 16 A filtered integrated socket (2-80 MHz noise filter).

label: devolo Magic 2 WiFi 6 next powerline access point
description: G.hn powerline access point: 2400 Mbps MIMO / 1200 Mbps SISO over mains, plus Wi-Fi 6 dual-band dual-concurrent (574 Mbps 2.4 GHz + 2402 Mbps 5 GHz). Two Gigabit Ethernet ports and a filtered 16 A pass-through socket.

label: Zyxel PLA5456 AV2000 passthrough powerline adapter
description: HomePlug AV2 MIMO adapter with a maximum PHY rate of 1800 Mbps over powerline (sold as AV2000). Two Gigabit Ethernet ports and an AC pass-through socket so the wall outlet stays usable.

label: Zyxel PLA6456 G.hn Wave 2 passthrough adapter
description: G.hn Wave 2 (ITU-T G.9963) powerline adapter, marketed as G.hn 2400 while Zyxel's own feature table gives a 1200 Mbps maximum PHY rate over powerline. One Gigabit Ethernet port and an AC pass-through socket.

label: TRENDnet TPL-430AP Powerline 1200 AV2 access point
description: HomePlug AV2 MIMO powerline 1200 adapter fused with an AC1200 dual-band access point: three Gigabit Ethernet ports (6 Gbps switching capacity), 300 Mbps 2.4 GHz + 867 Mbps 5 GHz Wi-Fi, 300 m powerline range, no passthrough socket.

label: D-Link DHP-P701AV PowerLine AV2 2000 passthrough kit
description: HomePlug AV2 MIMO kit of two DHP-P700AV adapters, up to 2000 Mbps powerline PHY (D-Link's spec table quotes 1900 Mbps). Each adapter has one Gigabit Ethernet port and a noise-filtered passthrough socket rated 15 A.

label: ScreenBeam (Actiontec) ECB7250 MoCA 2.5 adapter
description: Bonded MoCA 2.5 network adapter with a 2.5Gbps MoCA PHY and one 10/100/2500BASE-T RJ45 port - ScreenBeam's first-to-market 2.5GbE MoCA adapter, giving multi-gigabit full-duplex over existing coax. Backward compatible with MoCA 2.0/1.1/1.0, up to 16 nodes; the same hardware is sold as the Actiontec ECB7250.

label: ScreenBeam (Actiontec) ECB6200 Bonded MoCA 2.0 adapter
description: Bonded MoCA 2.0 Ethernet-over-coax adapter: up to 1.0 Gbps throughput over existing coax, backward compatible with MoCA 2.0/1.1/1.0, up to 16 nodes. One 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 port and one coax (F-type) port; sold today under the ScreenBeam brand, originally Actiontec ECB6200.

label: goCoax MA2500D MoCA 2.5 adapter
description: MoCA 2.5 adapter with up to 5 bonded channels and 2.5 Gbps real traffic throughput. One 2.5GbE RJ45 LAN port and one MoCA coax port (1125-1675 MHz), up to 16 nodes; wall- or desk-mountable.

label: goCoax WF-803M MoCA 2.5 adapter
description: Earlier goCoax MoCA 2.5 adapter: 2.5 Gbps over coax but only a single Gigabit RJ45 port - goCoax's own MA2500D page documents the upgrade from the WF-803M's 1GbE port to 2.5GbE. One coax port, up to 16 nodes.

label: Translite TL-MC84 MoCA 2.5 adapter
description: MoCA 2.5 adapter (1125-1675 MHz) with 2.5 Gbps over coax and two Gigabit Ethernet ports that behave as a small hub for a TV plus a console/PC. One coax port, web management, up to 16 adapters in a network.

label: Translite TL-9802 G.hn over coax Ethernet bridge
description: G.hn Wave 2 Ethernet-over-coax CPE/bridge for MDU and SFU deployments: two Gigabit Ethernet ports, a coax port with TV RF pass-through, up to 1 Gbps data rate and up to 16 bridges per network. Frequency-band plan avoids live CATV.

label: Comtrend GCA-6000 G.hn Ethernet over Coax adapter
description: G.hn Ethernet-over-coax adapter with a 1200 Mbps PHY: one 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 and one F-type coax connector (built-in 100 MHz diplexer optional). Dark coax only - it cannot share a cable carrying live CATV/satellite; up to 32 nodes.

label: PLANET VC-231 VDSL2 Ethernet extender
description: Point-to-point VDSL2 (G.993.2 17a/30a) Ethernet extender used in CO/CPE pairs to run Ethernet over existing phone wire: one 10/100BASE-TX RJ45 and one RJ11 telephone jack, up to 100/100 Mbps symmetric at 200 m and 22/19 Mbps at 1.4 km.

label: PLANET VC-231G VDSL2 Ethernet extender (gigabit)
description: VDSL2 35b Super Vectoring + G.vectoring Ethernet extender pair for phone wire: one 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 and one RJ11 port, up to 200/200 Mbps symmetric at 200 m and 21/13 Mbps at 1.4 km, CO/CPE selectable by DIP switch.
